field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.in_language: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].
field_descriptions.phonetic_text: Representation of a text [[textValue]] using the specified [[speechToTextMarkup]]. For example the city name of Houston in IPA: /ˈhjuːstən/.
field_descriptions.speech_to_text_markup: Form of markup used. eg. [SSML](https://www.w3.org/TR/speech-synthesis11) or [IPA](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Property:P898).
